# WebPushSubscribeStatus

`Flare.Components.WebPushSubscribeStatus`

How a call to SubscribeAsync ended.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Subscribed` | `0` | The service worker is subscribed; Subscription holds the subscription to send to the server. |
| `Unsupported` | `1` | The browser cannot receive push messages in this context. |
| `PermissionNotGranted` | `2` | The notification permission is not granted. Ask for it with RequestPermissionAsync from a user action first. |
| `NoServiceWorker` | `3` | The page has no registered service worker to receive the messages. |
| `KeyMismatch` | `4` | A subscription made with a different server key already exists. Unsubscribe first - and let the server forget the old subscription - then subscribe with the new key. |
| `Failed` | `5` | The browser or its push service rejected the subscription; Error says why. |
